title: fix-network capability
description: What the tool can do for the person at the Mac, and the rules that limit who may make it change things.

entities.name: Mac network diagnosis and repair
entities.description: Diagnoses the Mac's link, public internet, VPN, routing, corporate DNS, corporate services and proxies, and repairs what it safely can.
entities.responsibility: Tell the person what is wrong with the Mac's network, dimension by dimension, and what it takes to fix each problem, then run the allowed repairs and verify again.
access: Anyone who can run the binary on macOS may diagnose; on any other OS every command is refused with exit status 2 (run).
Repairs that need root go through sudo with the caller's own password; without a terminal sudo -n fails instead of prompting (sys::argv).
Reconnecting a VPN, disabling proxies and flushing routes need --vpn, --fix-proxy and --allow-route-flush (Step::gate, Gates::blocked).
Inside an SSH session, steps that can cut it (VPN reconnect, DHCP renew, Wi-Fi cycle, route flush) need --allow-remote (Step::disruptive, Gates::blocked).
